2. Reason: The planner’s instructions exhibit confirmation bias—framing the search to validate erosion as the primary mechanism instead of neutrally comparing all plateau formation processes. This bias could lead to overlooking evidence that volcanic (lava) plateaus are a major, often test-keyed mechanism, thereby risking an incorrect conclusion. A balanced search comparing erosional, tectonic, and volcanic plateaus across standard references would be more appropriate.
